title: The Figure a Household Owes on a Snowsports School Booking and the Amount Collected Against It
content:
When a household settles what it owes the Snowsports School on one of its bookings, the figure collected is worked out from the entries standing on that booking's school account rather than from the figure printed on any earlier confirmation.

## 1. The figure owed

The figure owed is the tuition raised against the booking, plus the add-ons raised against it, plus the school fees raised against it, less the payments already collected on it.

## 2. The amount collected

The amount collected is that figure owed, and the result is rounded to the nearest cent.

The school credit set against the figure owed stands at 0.00 USD, and money is taken for what is left, which is never less than nothing. The share of what is left that is collected stands at 100 percent. The reduction in percentage points allowed on the figure so reached stands at 0 points, and the reduction in money allowed on it stands at 0.00 USD.

The points reduction acts on the figure left once the share has been taken; the reduction in money is then taken off that result; and the amount collected is what remains, rounded to the nearest cent. Where the reductions come to more than the figure, nothing is collected.

## 3. A statement of account worked through on hypothetical entries

Take a Snowsports School booking whose account carries the following entries on the handling date.

| Entry standing on the account | Amount (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| tuition raised | 749.00 |
| add-on raised | 119.00 |
| school fee raised | 25.00 |
| payment already collected | 187.25 |

The tuition, the add-on and the fee together come to 893.00 USD; less the payment already collected of 187.25 USD, the figure owed is 705.75 USD.

School credit set against it takes off 0.00 USD, leaving 705.75 USD. The share collected is the whole of that, 705.75 USD. The points reduction takes off 0.00 USD and the reduction in money takes off a further 0.00 USD. The amount collected is therefore 705.75 USD.

## 4. Points of judgement on the entries counted

- Every tuition, add-on and fee entry standing on that booking's account is counted, whatever it was raised for; entries standing on another booking of the same household account are not.
- Payments already collected on the booking are taken off, so a household that has paid part of its tuition owes only the rest.
- Where the payments already collected come to more than the tuition, the add-ons and the fees together, the figure owed falls below nothing and no money is taken.
